questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the direct scan or simulation approach for Encode and Decode Strings?

choices.label: Drop empty strings while encoding.
choices.feedback: Decoding must reproduce empty elements and their positions too.

choices.label: Join strings with a separator and split on that separator.
choices.feedback: Input strings may contain the separator, so boundaries become ambiguous.

choices.label: Prefix a length but read only one digit of it.
choices.feedback: Strings of length ten or greater require multi-digit lengths.

choices.label: Encode each string as its length, a separator, and its contents. Decode by reading the length and then exactly that many characters.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Encode each string as its length, a separator, and its contents. Decode by reading the length and then exactly that many characters.
